# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 02 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches & Land Sales

- **Thomson Reserve sells 1,143 units in two days at 90% take-up** - All 3-bedroom and 4-bedroom units were sold at launch, leaving 123 two-bedders and 2 five-bedroom suites remaining, priced from $1.635M. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/thomson-reserve-sold-1143-units/)

- **Orchard Boulevard GLS site secured by Hong Leong Holdings and TID at $181.9 million** - The joint venture topped five bids for the site, with analysts expecting new homes to launch from $3,500 psf. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/new-orchard-boulevard-condo-launch/)

- **Two GLS Reserve List sites at Chuan Grove and former Raffles Town Club could add 1,180 homes** - URA has released both sites under the 2H2026 GLS Reserve List, spanning Chuan Grove and Plymouth Avenue/Dunearn Road. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/gls-reserve-list-site-chuan-grove-former-raffles-town-club-1180-homes/)

## Condo Resale Market

- **Condo resale volumes rose 10.8% month-on-month in September 2026** - An estimated 1,093 units changed hands, with price gains largely driven by stronger performance in the Core Central Region. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-resale-activity-recovers-as-prices-continue-to-rise-in-september-2026/)

## HDB Resale

- **Singapore's first S$1.8M HDB resale flat transacted at SkyParc @ Dawson, Queenstown** - The 5-room flat sold for S$1.818 million, setting a new record on both absolute price and psf basis for the unit type, sitting $588,000 above Queenstown's 12-month median of $1.23M. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/first-s1-8m-hdb-resale-flat-in-singapore-recorded-in-queenstown/)
